title: observability: refine token+KV cost/latency dashboards and alert thresholds
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: token-level cost/latency dashboards and KV cache metrics are critical for SLOs and cost accountability. This PR refines a set of dashboard panels, tightens alert thresholds, and improves labels/aggregation for token+KV metrics so on-call and platform teams get fewer noisy alerts while preserving sensitivity to real regressions. Includes metric renames for clarity, an exporter fix for duplicate tags, and dashboard layout adjustments. See linked Linear tasks ENG-2481 and SRE-102. TL;DR: reduce false positives from spikey traces, split per-customer and per-model rollups, and add contextual links to runbooks.

review_comments: Samir Gupta: Overall looks good. A couple questions: 1) Risk of metric rename breaking existing dashboard queries in Dedicated customers? 2) Why move to 'shard' tag instead of 'host'?

Maya Patel (author): For (1) we keep a compatibility shim for two releases (see kv_metrics.go) that emits both names. We'll deprecate the old name in the release notes. For (2) 'shard' maps to logical GPU shard (multiple pods can run per host) and gives better cardinality for batching use-cases.
Elena Torres: Alert tuning values look reasonable but suggest we add a 30-minute mute window for known daily batch spikes and document it in the runbook.
Maya Patel: Added mute window as annotation in alert_policies.yaml and documented the rationale in docs/observability/alerting.md (see commit a5c6d78).
Chris Nguyen: small nit: tracing_exporter.go had a potential NPE when model_alias is empty; good catch. Please add a unit test (done in b6d7e89).
Samir Gupta: CI flaky on metrics unit test initially, reran and passed. Approving now.
Elena Torres: Approved after tests and the runbook link.
release_notes: Refined token + KV cost/latency dashboards, metric rename (redwood_kv_cache_hits_total -> redwood_kv_cache_hit_count) with compatibility shim, tuned alert thresholds to reduce false positives, added runbook links and 30-minute mute window for daily batch spikes.
notes_for_ops: Compatibility: old metric name emitted alongside new name for two releases. Update any downstream queries before deprecation.
Runbook: docs/observability/alerting.md contains escalation steps and links to dashboards.
Mute window: alert_policies.yaml includes a 30-minute mute annotation for scheduled batch windows.
